whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bihta Junction Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews on NH30 in Bihta, but currently relies only on third-party aggregator links instead of a dedicated brand website for direct table bookings and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservation, aur authentic customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bihtajunction

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Bihta Junction Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and mobile-first menu display for customers traveling along NH30. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
